svg.title: Asked my assistant: What did he automate at Capgemini?
svg.desc: At Capgemini, Shubham automated repetitive reporting tasks in incident tracking and follow-up using Python. He also built a Python tool that used a language model to turn prose access requests into proposed Active Directory account and access changes for his review, which saved roughly 2 to 5 hours of his own time a week. Sources: Putting a language model in front of Active Directory access requests, with me as the approval step; Keep a human approval step between the language model and Active Directory; The seven questions I get asked, and my actual answers.
